 Immanuel Quickley amassed 17 points (7-of-18 FGs), six rebounds, six assists, two steals and three three-pointers in Sunday’s loss to the Knicks.
 After dropping 26 points on the 76ers Thursday night, Quickley had a relatively quiet night against the Knicks. Limited to five points through the first three quarters, IQ scored eight in the fourth quarter and another four in overtime. Quickley and the Raptors will look to end their 14-game losing streak to the Knicks in Tuesday’s rematch. 
 -  Raphielle Johnson

 Immanuel Quickley lit up the 76ers on Thursday with 26 points (8-of-16 FGs, 7-of-8 FTs), four rebounds, six assists, one steal, one block and three three-pointers. 
 After being held to a season-low 11 points on Wednesday, Quickley got back on track in this one. He fell one point shy of matching his season high for scoring, which was the only other game he has shot at least 50 percent from the floor this season. It has been a solid season so far for Quickley despite his field goal percentage being rough to this point. He’ll look to build off this one with the Knicks coming to Toronto on Sunday.

 Immanuel Quickley scored 11 points (3-of-14 FGs, 4-of-4 FTs), four rebounds, four assists, a steal, and a three in 98-93 loss to the Celtics. 
 IQ was returning from a hamstring injury and this was his first game back. On the season, IQ has been shooting 38.7% from the field which is just not good enough. He’s a career 42.4% field goal shooter which should show that there is room for him to bounce back, but it’s undoubtedly been a slow start efficiency wise. The next opportunity to bounce back will be on Thursday against the Sixers.

 Immanuel Quickley 
 TOR 
 Guard 
 #5 
 Immanuel Quickley finished Monday’s win over the Clippers with 27 points (8-of-13 FGs, 10-of-11 FTs), four rebounds, two assists, one steal and one three-pointer. 
 The Raptors entered the third quarter trailing by 13, but thanks to the tandem of Quickley and Scottie Barnes, they managed to walk down the Clippers and win by seven. Quickley and Barnes scored 29 of Toronto’s 47 points in the quarter, with Quickley providing 14. It’s early, but IQ has been close to a top-50 player in nine-cat formats, exceeding his Yahoo ADP by a comfortable margin.

 Thomas Sorber (knee) underwent a procedure on his right knee on Tuesday and will be re-evaluated in 6-8 weeks. 
 Sorber, who suffered a torn ACL during his lone season at Georgetown, missed the entire 2025-26 season and has yet to make his NBA debut.
